headline: Slovene 2025 PIT, contributions and child benefit in Lean (OECD 56/56 lines exact); child-benefit class notches cost up to 942 € for 1 € more income, families can gain up to 878 € by claiming less child allowance, flat-rate s.p. families keeping 50.000 € get the maximum child benefit, and the dependent-spouse rule taxes a spouse's first euro of wages at up to 1.420 €.
